name: Sai Bhaji (Sindhi Vegetable Curry)
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 3 small bunches fenugreek leaves, finely chopped
Small amount of soy leaves, finely chopped

steps: Soak the chana dal overnight. Drain and transfer dal to a pot.
Add the ginger and chiles to the dal. Cover with water, and boil for at least 5 minutes until tender. Drain.
Heat the oil in a pan. Add the fenugreek leaves, spinach, soy leaves, tomatoes, eggplant, potatoes, and okra. Cook until the greens are well-wilted.
Fry the garlic in some oil until golden. Stir in the salt, turmeric, and chile powder.
Stir the garlic and dal into the vegetables.

culture.text: A bhaji is a type of fritter originating in the Indian subcontinent. It is made from spicy hot vegetables, commonly onion, and has several variants. It is a popular snack food in India and is also very popular in Pakistan. It can be found for sale in street-side stalls, especially in tapris and dhabas. It is a common starter in Indian restaurant cuisine across the United Kingdom.
